title: What AutoDiag checks (diagnostic rules)
keywords: autodiag rules rule checks what does it check findings codes selftest domain rmw qos discovery shared memory severity
text: AutoDiag has 23 rules: the environment (ROS not sourced, invalid or unsafe domain IDs, no network interfaces), two-machine differences (domain, RMW including Zenoh vs DDS, distro, discovery range, localhost-only, multicast), DDS configuration files (missing XML, Cyclone config with another RMW), topic QoS (reliability, durability, latched data with a volatile subscriber, message type) and transports (shared memory across containers, intra-process expectations). Each finding has a code, a severity, evidence, a next step and official documentation; dds-autodiag selftest checks every rule against its synthetic faults.
